cast.name: August Pullman
cast.role: protagonist — 10-year-old boy with a craniofacial condition, starting fifth grade at Beecher Prep for the first time
cast.look: small, ten-year-old boy with a distinctive craniofacial difference — misaligned jaw and brow, warm brown eyes, unruly dark brown hair, jeans and a hoodie, carries himself with quiet confidence once he finds his footing

cast.name: Via Pullman
cast.role: Auggie's older sister — a high-school freshman who has spent years being invisible in her brother's shadow
cast.look: fifteen-year-old girl, slender, long dark brown hair pulled back, expressive dark eyes, oversized plaid shirt and dark jeans, quietly serious

cast.name: Jack Will
cast.role: Auggie's first real friend — initially recruited by Tushman, he genuinely chooses Auggie's side after the Halloween betrayal
cast.look: ten-year-old boy, average build, sandy blond hair, open freckled face, blue striped t-shirt and jeans, fidgets with his hands when uncertain

cast.name: Summer Dawson
cast.role: girl who sits with Auggie on the first day out of genuine kindness — not pity, not a dare
cast.look: ten-year-old girl, medium build, warm brown skin, tight curly hair in two puffs, bright yellow t-shirt and purple jeans, laughs easily

cast.name: Julian Albans
cast.role: the bully — popular, handsome, runs a whisper campaign against Auggie that stays just under adult radar
cast.look: ten-year-old boy, well-built, neatly combed dark hair, preppy polo shirt, expensive sneakers, a smile that does not reach his eyes

cast.name: Charlotte
cast.role: the neutral — knows what is wrong but protects her own social standing instead of acting
cast.look: ten-year-old girl, slight, straight blonde hair in a neat ponytail, pink cardigan over white top, always holding a notebook, guarded expression

cast.name: Mr. Tushman
cast.role: middle school principal — well-meaning architect of Auggie's welcome, installs 'moral training wheels' by choosing Auggie's first friends
cast.look: fifties, trim build, salt-and-pepper hair, reading glasses on a lanyard, navy blazer and khakis, gentle eyes behind an official smile

cast.name: Isabel Pullman
cast.role: Auggie's mother — former children's book illustrator, devoted but also complicit in her son's over-protection
cast.look: early forties, warm brown hair in a loose bun, paint-stained fingers she never quite cleans, floral blouse and cardigan, always looks like she is about to say something and decides not to
